svg.title: Twelve observed station histories
svg.desc: Original layered PM2.5 traces from sampled observed test targets. A shared vertical scale and chronological horizontal axis are used. Artistic vertical offsets separate stations; this is not a map.
svg.metadata: Source: Song Chen (2017), UCI Beijing Multi-Site Air Quality, doi:10.24432/C5RK5G. Derived artwork: StationShift, CC BY 4.0. Generated by scripts/build_hero.py.
